title: The Seminar That Changed Its Mind · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (120–150 words) about a time when you had to change a plan because of new information. Explain what the original plan was, what new information you found, and what you changed. Use at least two past perfect sentences and one object clause.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
